g.title: RHABDO_QSP_Model
g.text: Rhabdomyolysis-Induced Acute Kidney Injury — QSP Mechanistic Map
Tubular toxic exposure is a PRODUCT of three terms — filtered myoglobin load ÷ urine flow × f
(urine pH) — and the three standard therapies each move exactly ONE of them,
so the marginal value of each falls as the others succeed. One pressure variable (ΔP = MAP − P
) gates TWO opposite processes: necrosis needs ischaemia, washout needs perfusion.

One release drives TWO clocks: creatine kinase (t½ ≈ 36 h) integrates the insult while myoglobin (t½ ≈ 2.4 h) tracks its instantaneous rate — which is why the number the clinician sees peaks a day late.

g.title: cluster_aeti
g.text: ⚡ Aetiology — every cause enters through one of only TWO doors: mechanical/ischaemic or metabolic/toxic

g.title: cluster_myo
g.text: 🔬 Myocyte energetic failure — the final common path is cytosolic Ca²⁺

g.title: cluster_press
g.text: 🔒 THE PRESSURE NODE — ΔP gates necrosis and washout in OPPOSITE directions

g.title: cluster_rel
g.text: ⏱ Release and the TWO CLOCKS — same flux, two half-lives, two different stories

g.title: cluster_vol
g.text: 💧 Volume — the injured muscle is a sink that competes with the kidney for the fluid you give

g.title: cluster_glom
g.text: 🩺 Filtration and tubular handling — a saturable transporter splits ONE load into TWO toxic arms

g.title: cluster_heme
g.text: 🧪 Heme chemistry — pH decides how much of the myoglobin becomes a toxin

g.title: cluster_cast
g.text: 🧱 Cast physics — a concentration-SQUARED process, so flow is worth more than it looks

g.title: cluster_vaso
g.text: 🩸 Arm C — renal vasoconstriction and medullary hypoxia

g.title: cluster_inj
g.text: ⚙️ Injury integration — THREE PARALLEL ARMS ADD, which is why blocking one has a ceiling

g.title: cluster_inf
g.text: 🔥 Inflammation — the same macrophages that clear the debris close the capillary leak

g.title: cluster_elec
g.text: 🧫 Electrolytes — potassium is a positive-feedback loop; calcium is biphasic by construction

g.title: cluster_tph
g.text: 💊 THERAPY 2 — alkali: the CHEMISTRY term f_diss(pH)

g.title: cluster_adj
g.text: ⚠️ Adjuncts — three of these move a term, two mostly add a fourth injury arm
